v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Lapidavérunt Stéphanum, * et ipse invocábat Dóminum, dicens: Ne státuas illis hoc peccátum.
text.en: They stoned Stephen, * calling upon God, and saying: Lay not this sin to their charge.

text.la: Lápides torréntis * illi dulces fuérunt: ipsum sequúntur omnes ánimæ iustæ.
text.en: The stones of the brook * were sweet to him; all the souls of the righteous follow him.

text.la: Adhǽsit ánima mea * post te, quia caro mea lapidáta est pro te, Deus meus.
text.en: O my God, my soul followeth hard after thee, * for my flesh hath been stoned for thy sake.

text.la: Stéphanus vidit * cælos apértos, vidit, et introívit: beátus homo, cui cæli patébant.
text.en: Stephen saw the heavens opened; * he saw and entered in; blessed is he unto whom the heavens were opened.

text.la: Ecce vídeo * cælos apértos, et Iesum stantem a dextris virtútis Dei.
text.en: Behold, I see * the heavens opened, and Jesus standing on the right hand of the power of God.

text.la: Stéphanus autem plenus grátia et fortitúdine, faciébat prodígia et signa magna in pópulo.
text.en: And Stephen, full of grace and fortitude, did great wonders and signs among the people.

r.la: Et fecérunt planctum magnum super eum.
r.en: And made great mourning over him.

text.la: Stéphanus autem * plenus grátia et fortitúdine, faciébat signa magna in pópulo.
text.en: And Stephen, full of grace * and fortitude, did great signs among the people.

text.la: Da nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, imitári quod cólimus: ut discámus et inimícos dilígere; quia eius natalícia celebrámus, qui novit étiam pro persecutóribus exoráre Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum:
text.en: Grant us, we beseech thee, O Lord, so to imitate what we revere, that we may learn to love even our enemies; for we celebrate the heavenly birthday of him who knew how to pray for his very persecutors to our Lord Jesus Christ: Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

text.la: Glória in excélsis Deo, et in terra pax homínibus bonæ voluntátis, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Glory be to God in the highest; and on earth, peace to men of good will, alleluia, alleluia.

v.en: The Lord hath made known, alleluia.

text.la: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut nos Unigéniti tui nova per carnem Natívitas líberet; quos sub peccáti iugo vetústa sérvitus tenet.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the new birth of thy Only-begotten Son as man may set us free, who are held by the old bondage under the yoke of sin.
